subject: Kickoff: NimbleCode x Redwood — Podcast + Webinar Series proposal
messages:
From: Danielle King <danielle.king@nimblecode.ai>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimblecode.ai>
Date: 2027-05-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NimbleCode x Redwood — Podcast + Webinar Series proposal

Hi Monica,

Hope you’re well — I’m Danielle on the Partnerships team at NimbleCode. We loved Redwood’s session at EdgeSummit earlier this year and think there’s a great fit for a short co-produced series: one conversational podcast episode (30–40 min) featuring an engineer/product owner + a hybrid webinar (45 min demo + 15 min Q&A) that targets mid-market SaaS platform teams.

Attached is a brief outline (nimblecode-proposal.pdf) with proposed themes, audience targets, and a high-level promo plan. Key asks from NimbleCode: co-host the podcast, joint promo (email + 1 paid social run), and a co-branded landing page. We can cover speaker fees for the podcast and put modest budget behind social.

Proposed timeline: record podcast late June, webinar in early July. We’d love to set a 30-minute kickoff this week to align on audience, speakers, and metrics.

Proposal attachments: [Attachment: nimblecode-proposal.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

Thanks — looking forward to hearing if this aligns.

Best,
Danielle King
Head of Partnerships | NimbleCode
Email: danielle.king@nimblecode.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0198
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Danielle King <danielle.king@nimblecode.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCode x Redwood — Podcast + Webinar Series proposal

Danielle — thanks for the note and the outline. Monica here, Alliances Manager at Redwood — really like the direction. A couple of quick clarifying items before we lock a time:

- Audience: can you share an attendee persona (SaaS product managers / platform engineers / revenue ops?) and a target list size for the webinar?
- Speakers: who from NimbleCode would you propose as the podcast co-host and webinar demo lead?
- Metrics: beyond registrations, what KPIs does NimbleCode care most about (pipeline influenced, MQLs, demo requests)?

Ben and Jonas — looping you both to confirm we have capacity on our side (audio + webinar ops) and to weigh in on promotional support (email cadence, paid social budget).

I can do a 30-minute sync Thursday 5/12 afternoon PST or Friday morning PST — here’s my Calendly: https://calendly.com/monica_patel/45min. If that works, we’ll send a calendar invite and a shared Drive folder for assets.

Attached for reference: [Attachment stub: draft-promo-blurb.docx] (we’ll craft co-branded copy once we confirm speakers).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Danielle King <danielle.king@nimblecode.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCode x Redwood — Podcast + Webinar Series proposal

Adding a few operational notes — copying Danielle to keep everything visible.

Monica / Jonas — quick answers from a field marketing perspective:
- Promo: We can commit to a single promotional email to our developer list (~18k) + an organic social push across X and LinkedIn. For paid social, recommend a $1,500 test spend to amplify webinar registrations (we can scale if conversion looks good).
- Assets needed: 1–2 sentence promo blurb, 50–100 word landing copy, headshots + bios for speakers, and a 20–30 second clip we can use as an ad creative post-recording.
- Ops: We’ll handle Zoom webinar host, registration page, and recording. Need final speaker list by 6/18 to leave time for rehearsals.

Draft promo blurb attached — please review and send edits.

Attachments: [Attachment: draft-promo-blurb.docx (DOCX, 12KB)]

Ben Carter
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Danielle King <danielle.king@nimblecode.ai>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimblecode.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCode x Redwood — Podcast + Webinar Series proposal

Great — thanks for the quick responses and helpful details.

Answers inline:
- Audience: primary target is platform engineering leads and ML/AI platform PMs at mid-market SaaS (50–500 engineers). We can share a short attendee persona doc in the Drive folder.
- Speakers: I propose Samir Patel (NimbleCode CTO) as podcast co-host and Priya Nadar (product lead) as webinar demo lead. I’ll confirm their availability but both are tentatively good for the timeline.
- KPIs: main focus is pipeline influenced and demo requests; secondary is content downloads and newsletter signups.

I’ve created a shared Drive folder and uploaded a speaker one-pager + our proposed landing page copy. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEFgHIjkLmnOP

I’ve also scheduled a 30-minute kickoff slots — please pick a time that works for you here: https://calendly.com/monica_patel/45min.

Attachments referenced: [Attachment: speaker-onepager.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

Looking forward to the collaboration — happy to iterate on the blurb in the Drive.

Best,
Danielle King
Head of Partnerships | NimbleCode
